Pump_Skid.label: 01 · Fabricated Steel Skid Baseplate
Pump_Skid.description: Fabricated steel baseplate keeping motor and pump aligned.

Skid_Bolt.label: 01 · Chockfast Foundation Bolts
Skid_Bolt.description: Foundation bolt securing the skid to the tanktop.

Motor_Body.label: 02 · 440 V TEFC Induction Motor
Motor_Body.description: 440 V 3-phase squirrel-cage induction motor driving the pump.

Motor_Cooling_Fin.label: 02 · Motor Stator Cooling Fins
Motor_Cooling_Fin.description: Circumferential cooling fins shedding stator heat to engine room air.

Motor_Terminal_Box.label: 02 · IP56 440 V Terminal Box
Motor_Terminal_Box.description: Watertight terminal box where the 440 V feeder cable lands.

Motor_End_Cap.label: 02 · Non-Drive-End Fan Cover
Motor_End_Cap.description: Non-drive-end cover protecting the cooling fan.

Shaft_Coupling.label: 03 · Flexible Spacer Coupling
Shaft_Coupling.description: Coupling transmitting torque and absorbing thermal misalignment.

Pump_Shaft.label: 03 · Stainless Alloy Drive Shaft
Pump_Shaft.description: Duplex stainless shaft carrying torque from motor to impeller.

Pump_Casing.label: 04 · Centrifugal Volute Casing
Pump_Casing.description: Spiral volute casing converting fluid kinetic energy into pressure head.

Casing_Cover.label: 04 · Rear Stuffing Box Cover
Casing_Cover.description: Rear casing cover closing the volute and housing the mechanical seal.

Impeller_.description: Rotating vaned wheel imparting centrifugal velocity to seawater.

Suction_Port.label: 06 · Axial Suction Nozzle
Suction_Port.description: Axial suction port drawing water from the sea chest.

Suction_Flange.label: 06 · DIN PN16 Suction Flange
Suction_Flange.description: Bolted flange connection to suction piping.

Discharge_Flange.label: 06 · DIN PN16 Discharge Flange
Discharge_Flange.description: Discharge flange feeding the main cooling water header.

Shaft_Seal.label: 07 · Cartridge Mechanical Shaft Seal
Shaft_Seal.description: Silicon-carbide mechanical seal stopping leakage along the shaft.

ballast.title: Ballast Pump & Oily Water Separator (OWS) Skid

Ballast_Pump_Casing.label: 01 · Cast-Bronze Centrifugal Volute Casing & Skid
Ballast_Pump_Casing.description: Heavy seawater-resistant bronze volute casing with flanged suction/discharge branches and channel skid base.

Pump_Impeller.label: 02 · Double-Curvature Bronze Impeller & Shaft
Pump_Impeller.description: Enclosed multi-vane bronze impeller keyed to stainless steel pump shaft for high-flow ballast transfer.

440V_Drive_Motor.label: 03 · 110 kW 440 V Vertical Drive Motor
440V_Drive_Motor.description: Vertical flange-mounted induction motor with cooling fins and moisture-sealed terminal box.

OWS_Pressure_Vessel.label: 04 · Two-Stage Bilge OWS Coalescer Vessel
OWS_Pressure_Vessel.description: Pressure vessel separating oil and water mixtures down to < 15 ppm conforming to IMO MEPC.107(49).

Coalescer_Filter.label: 05 · Oleophilic High-Efficiency Coalescer Pack
Coalescer_Filter.description: Removable oleophilic coalescing matrix filter element aggregating microscopic oil droplets.

Oil_Content_Monitor.label: 06 · 15 PPM Bilge Alarm Monitor (OCM) & 3-Way Valve
Oil_Content_Monitor.description: Optical measuring sensor analyzing effluent oil content with automatic 3-way discharge diversion valve.

Control_Panel.label: 07 · Automated PLC Skid Control Console
Control_Panel.description: Microprocessor control panel managing automated bilge oil discharge, level switches, and data logging.

ESB_Frame.description: Heavy structural steel switchboard cubicle with IP22 top drip canopy, side louvers, and foundation skid.

ESB_Door.label: 02 · Hinged Inspection Doors & Polycarbonate Windows
ESB_Door.description: Neoprene-gasketed front access doors (Bay 1 open for inspection) with interlock latches and mimic lines.

ESB_Busbar_A.label: 03 · 440 V Emergency Copper Busbar Section A
ESB_Busbar_A.description: Electrolytic copper busbars (L1/L2/L3 with Red/Yellow/Blue phase sleeves) supplying emergency steering and fire pump.

ESB_Busbar_B.label: 04 · 440 V Emergency Copper Busbar Section B
ESB_Busbar_B.description: Secondary emergency distribution copper busbars feeding navigation bridge and 24 V DC battery chargers.

ESB_Tie_ACB.label: 05 · Draw-Out Bus-Tie Air Circuit Breaker (ACB)
ESB_Tie_ACB.description: Withdrawable air circuit breaker with racking cradle, mechanical charge indicator, and solid-state trip unit.

ESB_Metering_Panel.label: 06 · Digital Multifunction Metering & Synchro Fascia
ESB_Metering_Panel.description: Analog white-dial meters, cyan LCD protection relays, synchroscope dial, and Red/Green/Amber status lamps.

ESB_Control_Wiring.label: 07 · DIN Terminal Rail, Molded MCCBs & Wiring Harness
ESB_Control_Wiring.description: Halogen-free control wiring trunking, outgoing feeder MCCBs, DIN rail terminal blocks, and earth bar.

eRadio.title: 24 V DC Battery Bank & GMDSS/UPS Charger Cabinet
eRadio.subtitle: SOLAS Emergency Radio Battery Bank · 12 × 2V VRLA Cells · Dual Thyristor Float/Boost Charger Cubicle

Battery_Rack_Frame.label: 01 · Acid-Resistant 2-Tier Seismic Battery Rack
Battery_Rack_Frame.description: Heavy epoxy-coated steel rack with yellow seismic retaining bars and overhead ATEX extraction hood.

Battery_Cell_01_12.label: 02 · 12 × 2V VRLA Deep-Cycle Marine Battery Cells
Battery_Cell_01_12.description: 12 valve-regulated lead-acid cells connected in series with electrolyte sight glasses and brass terminals.

DC_Busbar_Positive.label: 03 · Positive DC Inter-Cell Copper Busbar & HRC Fuse
DC_Busbar_Positive.description: Tinned copper inter-cell link bars with red insulation sleeves and main HRC fuse holder.

DC_Busbar_Negative.label: 04 · Negative DC Inter-Cell Copper Busbar & Shunt
DC_Busbar_Negative.description: Negative copper collector busbar with black insulation boots and calibrated brass ammeter shunt.

Charger_Cabinet.label: 05 · Dual Automatic Float/Boost Charger Cubicle
Charger_Cabinet.description: Switchboard-grade ventilated steel enclosure with digital rectifier LCD and status pilot lamps.

Rectifier_Transformer.label: 06 · Galvanic Isolation Transformer & SCR Heatsink
Rectifier_Transformer.description: Step-down isolation transformer with twin copper coils, finned aluminum SCR heatsink, and filter capacitor.

Ammeter_Gauge.label: 07 · Center-Zero Charge/Discharge DC Ammeter
Ammeter_Gauge.description: Analog charge/discharge ammeter with white dial face and deflecting red indicator needle.

airCompressor.title: Main Starting Air Compressor & Air Receiver Skid
airCompressor.subtitle: 30 bar V-Twin Two-Stage Starting Air Compressor · 30 kW Finned Motor · Cu-Ni Intercooler · Air Receiver Bottle

Compressor_Frame.description: Rigid steel bedplate with anti-vibration rubber mounts, oil drip coaming, and perforated yellow belt guard.

Electric_Motor_440V.label: 02 · 30 kW 440 V Finned Marine Induction Motor
Electric_Motor_440V.description: 30 kW TEFC squirrel-cage induction motor with circumferential cooling fins and IP56 terminal box.

V_Belt_Drive.label: 03 · Spoked Cast-Iron Compressor Flywheel Sheave
V_Belt_Drive.description: Dynamically balanced 6-spoke cast-iron flywheel pulley driven by the V-belt transmission.

Two_Stage_Cylinder.label: 04 · V-Twin LP & HP Finned Compression Cylinders
Two_Stage_Cylinder.description: Cast-iron crankcase with oil sight glass and angled LP (6 bar) and HP (30 bar) finned cylinders.

Intercooler_Coil.label: 05 · Copper-Nickel Finned Intercooler & Piping
Intercooler_Coil.description: Multi-pass finned copper intercooler shell and delivery piping reducing air temperature between stages.

Pressure_Receiver_Bottle.label: 06 · 30-Bar Vertical Starting Air Receiver Bottle
Pressure_Receiver_Bottle.description: Seamless forged steel 30-bar pressure vessel with red dome, brass stop valve, relief valve, and pressure gauge.

Solenoid_Unloader_Valve.label: 07 · Automatic Unloader Solenoid & Local Starter Box
Solenoid_Unloader_Valve.description: Brass/blue solenoid unloader valve, moisture separator trap, and local pressure switch starter box.

ventFan.title: Engine Room Heavy Axial Ventilation Fan & Starter Box
ventFan.subtitle: 45 kW Reversible High-Pressure Axial Fan · 8-Blade Aerofoil Impeller · Star-Delta Starter · Fire Damper

Fan_Cylindrical_Casing.label: Fan Cylindrical Casing & Saddles
Fan_Cylindrical_Casing.description: Cylindrical steel fan housing on saddle mounting legs with stiffening ribs, intake bellmouth, and top inspection access hatch.

Flange_Rings.label: Companion Flange Rings & Bolts
Flange_Rings.description: Front and rear companion flanges with 12-bolt rings connecting securely to the vessel's engine room ventilation trunking.

Axial_Impeller_Blades.label: 8-Blade Aerofoil Impeller & Hub
Axial_Impeller_Blades.description: Dynamically balanced 8-blade pitched aerofoil impeller with concentric nose spinner cap rotating at 1750 RPM.

440V_Drive_Motor.label: 440 V In-Stream Drive Motor
440V_Drive_Motor.material: Class H Marine IP56 TEFC Motor
440V_Drive_Motor.description: 45 kW marine flange induction motor cooled directly by supply airflow, supported on 4 aerodynamic guide-vane struts.

Local_Starter_Enclosure.label: Local Star-Delta Starter & Meter Box
Local_Starter_Enclosure.description: Local control cubicle equipped with Star-Delta contactors, ammeter gauge, cyan LCD, isolator switch, and pilot lamps.

Fire_Damper_Actuator.label: SOLAS Fire Damper Actuator & Linkage
Fire_Damper_Actuator.description: High-visibility safety red pneumatic spring-return actuator that snaps fire dampers shut upon engine room fire alarm.

galley440.title: 440 V Galley Primary Board (Ovens, Deep Fryers) & Shunt Trip
galley440.subtitle: 2-Bay 440 V Switchboard Cubicle · Stainless Roasting Ovens, Hotplates & Deep Fryers · Outdoor SOLAS Shunt Trip

Galley_Panel_Enclosure.label: 01 · 2-Bay 440 V Galley Switchboard & Cooking Range
Galley_Panel_Enclosure.description: Left: 2-bay marine switchboard with meters, LCDs, and open inspection door. Right: Stainless ovens, 4 hotplates, and twin deep fryers.

Feeder_MCCB_Bank.label: 02 · 3-Phase Copper Busbars & 6 Feeder MCCBs
Feeder_MCCB_Bank.description: Electrolytic copper busbars (Red/Yellow/Blue phase sleeves), 400 A Incomer MCCB, and 6 branch MCCBs.

Shunt_Trip_Relay.label: 03 · SOLAS 24 V DC Magnetic Shunt Trip Release
Shunt_Trip_Relay.description: Electromagnetic shunt trip coil mounted beside the main incomer to instantaneously trip all galley power.

Outdoor_Shunt_Trip_Box.label: 04 · Outdoor Weatherproof Shunt Trip Station
Outdoor_Shunt_Trip_Box.description: Safety yellow SOLAS emergency trip station mounted outside the galley entrance with armored conduit.

Red_Mushroom_Button.label: 05 · 40mm Latching Emergency Stop Mushroom Button
Red_Mushroom_Button.description: Twist-to-reset red mushroom pushbutton opening control circuit to trigger the galley feeder shunt trip.

Safety_Cover_Flap.label: 06 · Hinged Protective Safety Guard Flap
Safety_Cover_Flap.description: Yellow flip-up safety guard frame preventing accidental actuation during rough seas.

shore.title: 6.6 kV High-Voltage Shore Connection (HVSC) Box & Cable Reel
shore.subtitle: IEC/ISO/IEEE 80005-1 Cold Ironing Interface · Spoked Motorized Reel · 6.6 kV Switchboard Cubicle · CME Earth Switch

Cable_Reel_Drum.label: 01 · Motorized Flanged Spoked Cable Reel Drum
Cable_Reel_Drum.description: Heavy flanged steel drum with 6 radial stiffening spokes and slip-ring collector core.

HV_Flexible_Cable.label: 02 · 6.6 kV Heavy Flexible Cold-Ironing Cable Coils
HV_Flexible_Cable.description: Multi-turn coiled EPR-insulated 6.6 kV trailing cable with red high-voltage phase collar.

HV_Connector_Plug.label: 03 · IEC 80005-1 Shore Power Plug, Fairlead & Skid
HV_Connector_Plug.description: High-voltage shore coupling plug with copper pilot pins, roller fairlead, A-frame supports, and skid base.

Motorized_Drive.label: 04 · Planetary Electric Spooling Gearmotor
Motorized_Drive.description: Finned electric gearmotor and planetary gearbox maintaining constant cable tension during tidal changes.

Junction_Box.label: 05 · 6.6 kV HVSC Switchboard Terminal Cubicle
Junction_Box.description: Switchboard-style cubicle with 3 synchro gauges, cyan protection LCD, pilot lamps, and inspection window.

Mechanical_Interlock_Pin.label: 06 · Castell/Kirk Key Mechanical Interlock Assembly
Mechanical_Interlock_Pin.description: Trapped-key mechanical interlock preventing access or disconnection while the 6.6 kV shore breaker is closed.

Earth_Blade.label: 07 · 3-Pole Copper CME Earthing Switch & Insulators
Earth_Blade.description: Three-pole copper knife-blade earthing switch mounted on red HV standoff insulators inside the cubicle.

nav.title: Navigation Bridge COLREG Console & S-Band Radar Suite

NavLight_Console_Panel.description: Sloped wheelhouse console with dual 27-inch cyan ARPA/ECDIS displays, stainless grab rail, helm wheel, and engine telegraph.

Dual_Selector_Switches.label: COLREG 72 Navigation Light Mimic & Selector Bank
Dual_Selector_Switches.description: Vessel silhouette mimic plate with port/starboard LEDs and 10 Main/Standby dual-filament toggle switches.

Alarm_Buzzer.label: Audible Failure Sounder & BNWAS Beacon
Alarm_Buzzer.description: Acoustic navigation light filament failure alarm buzzer and dual flashing red/amber watch safety beacons.

Radar_Pedestal.label: Tapered Masthead Radar Scanner Pedestal
Radar_Pedestal.description: Marine white-enamel tapered pedestal column with bolted 8-hole deck flange and service access door.

Gearbox_Housing.label: S-Band Transceiver & Harmonic Turning Gearbox
Gearbox_Housing.description: Finned transceiver reduction gearbox with yellow safety lock-out switch, cooling ribs, and optical rotary joint.

Rotating_S-Band_Scanner_Bar.label: 12-Foot Aerodynamic S-Band Waveguide Scanner
Rotating_S-Band_Scanner_Bar.description: 12-foot aerodynamic S-Band slotted waveguide antenna array with safety red tips rotating at 24 RPM for target detection.
